title: AI panel model list: drop the per-model cost multiplier in favour of a cost word, or keep it under the "see the multiplier when choosing" condition?
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Split from #35445 by seat 5 (area ux-1): item 5 asks for the model list to show a cost word (「消耗较多」-like) instead of the ×1 / ×2.2 / ×20 / ×40 multipliers. ⛔ Not a claim. PR #35573 drops the multiplier from the closed picker only, and keeps it in the open list and the ×20 confirm.

## Why it is held

An earlier condition set by the account owner for opening the paid model picker on production (cloud#4536), quoted on #33660 in triage comment 6889924748: 「只要选择时能够看清楚倍数」 (the multiplier must be visible at the moment of choosing). Figure 27 on #35445 annotates only the closed picker: 「只显示档位名，不显示倍率」. Removing the multiplier from the open list would reverse that condition, so it waits on the maintainer.

## The decision owed

- A: keep the multipliers in the open list and the ×20 confirm, as shipped in PR #35573; this card closes.
- B: replace them with a cost word. This supersedes the cloud#4536 condition. A follow-up PR then changes about one file and two pins.

Seat recommendation: A. The condition governs the moment of choice, and the figure marks only the closed picker.

## Done when

The maintainer has chosen. Under B, a dispatch card carries the change.
